author: reek
body: Dropdown is reached by DiffusionApp through SettingsPanel, which calls dropdown-widget for every SfDropdown field, so the closed trigger is live. Opening, filtering, highlighting and confirming are reached by nothing, which is where the questions are: a control that cannot be opened from the keyboard is the same shape of defect TextField and TreeView both carried.

author: reek
body: A dropdown with nothing chosen must say so rather than naming an option, and an index outside the option list must answer empty rather than reading past the end.

author: reek
body: Eleven options, a cap of eight. The filter takes every option containing the letter o, which is six of the eleven and not a prefix of them.

author: reek
body: The highlight indexes the VISIBLE options, so confirming has to map it back through the full list. Under a filter those two spaces differ, which is the case that tells a correct mapping from one that returns the highlight as an option index.

author: reek
body: A highlight past the end of the visible list must decline rather than choose. dropdown-with-selected seeds the highlight from an index into the FULL list, so a selection beyond the visible cap produces exactly that.
